ble_219_0c041cf8.name: app_magic_flag_set
ble_219_0c041cf8.summary: Set or clear the 0x5a465459 magic flag word depending on param_1==1
ble_219_0c041cf8.description: Writes the magic constant 0x5a465459 (bytes 'Y','T','F','Z' in memory) to the RAM word DAT_2000018c when param_1 == 1, otherwise writes 0. Together with app_magic_flag_is_set it implements a persistent boolean flag held in an early .data word that survives as a magic-value rather than a plain 0/1. The meaning of the flag (probably a boot/factory/mode switch) is not visible from this function; its only caller is ble_219_0c02c49c.

params.name: param_1
params.description: 1 = arm the flag; any other value clears it

ble_219_0c041cf8.notes: Purpose of the flag inferred only from the magic value; not confirmed.

ble_219_0c041d10.name: app_magic_flag_is_set
ble_219_0c041d10.summary: Test whether the 0x5a465459 magic flag in DAT_2000018c is armed
ble_219_0c041d10.description: Returns true when the RAM word DAT_2000018c equals the magic value 0x5a465459, i.e. when app_magic_flag_set(1) was last called. Pure getter, no side effects. Called from ble_219_0c02c49c and ble_219_0c02cca8.

returns.description: true if the magic flag is armed

ble_219_0c04211c.name: rtos_pool_node_alloc_init
ble_219_0c04211c.summary: Pop a node from a free list under a BASEPRI critical section and initialise it
ble_219_0c04211c.description: Enters a critical section (raises BASEPRI to 0x40 if running privileged; when not already nested it records the caller address 0xc04212a and LR in DAT_20003d70/DAT_20003d74 as a lock-owner trace and clears DAT_20003d70 to -1 on exit). Takes the head of the singly linked free list DAT_2000c720 (next pointer at node+4) and advances the head. If a node was obtained, checks that its state byte (offset 0) is 0 - otherwise it spins forever as an assertion - then stores param_1 at +0xc and param_2 at +0x10, zeroes the 32-bit field at +4..+7 and marks the node in use (state byte = 1). Returns the node, or NULL if the pool was empty.

returns.description: allocated node or NULL if the free list is empty

ble_219_0c04211c.notes: Node type unknown (looks like an RTOS control block / message / timer slot pool). Sole caller ble_219_0c03bb70.

ble_219_0c0427f0.name: app_noop_hook_0c0427f0
ble_219_0c0427f0.summary: Empty function (single return), never called directly
ble_219_0c0427f0.description: Contains only a return instruction. It has no direct callers, so it is an unused weak-default or an indirect hook/callback slot (possibly a FreeRTOS vApplicationIdleHook/vApplicationTickHook style stub).

ble_219_0c042800.name: vApplicationGetIdleTaskMemory
ble_219_0c042800.summary: Provide static TCB and stack buffers for the idle task (FreeRTOS static allocation)
ble_219_0c042800.description: FreeRTOS configSUPPORT_STATIC_ALLOCATION callback: stores the address of the TCB buffer 0x2000cb2c in *param_1, the address of the stack buffer 0x2000c72c in *param_2 and the stack depth 0x100 words (1 KiB) in *param_3. The buffers are adjacent (0x2000c72c + 0x400 = 0x2000cb2c). Called from ble_219_0c043e70, which is most likely vTaskStartScheduler creating the idle task.

params.name: param_1
params.description: out: StaticTask_t** receiving the TCB buffer pointer

params.name: param_2
params.description: out: StackType_t** receiving the stack buffer pointer

params.name: param_3
params.description: out: uint32_t* receiving the stack size in words (0x100)

ble_219_0c042800.notes: Could be the timer-task variant (vApplicationGetTimerTaskMemory) - idle assumed from the caller.

ble_219_0c0429a4.name: vListInitialise
ble_219_0c0429a4.summary: FreeRTOS: initialise an empty list with its end marker
ble_219_0c0429a4.description: FreeRTOS vListInitialise on a 0x14-byte List_t: sets pxIndex (offset 4) to the embedded xListEnd mini item at offset 8, sets xListEnd.xItemValue to 0xFFFFFFFF (portMAX_DELAY) so it always sorts last, points xListEnd.pxNext (+0xc) and pxPrevious (+0x10) back at itself and sets uxNumberOfItems (offset 0) to 0. Used by the kernel task lists and queues.

ble_219_0c0429bc.name: vListInitialiseItem
ble_219_0c0429bc.summary: FreeRTOS: mark a list item as not belonging to any list
ble_219_0c0429bc.description: FreeRTOS vListInitialiseItem: stores 0 in pvContainer (offset 0x10) of the ListItem_t so listIS_CONTAINED_WITHIN reports false.

ble_219_0c0429c4.name: vListInsertEnd
ble_219_0c0429c4.summary: FreeRTOS: insert an item at the end of a list (before pxIndex)
ble_219_0c0429c4.description: FreeRTOS vListInsertEnd: links param_2 immediately before the list's pxIndex item (list+4), i.e. at the logical end of the round-robin ring: new->pxNext (+4) = pxIndex, new->pxPrevious (+8) = pxIndex->pxPrevious, the neighbours are re-linked, new->pvContainer (+0x10) = list and uxNumberOfItems (list+0) is incremented. Used for ready lists and event lists.

ble_219_0c0429e4.name: vListInsert
ble_219_0c0429e4.summary: FreeRTOS: insert an item into a list sorted by xItemValue
ble_219_0c0429e4.description: FreeRTOS vListInsert: if the new item's xItemValue is 0xFFFFFFFF (portMAX_DELAY) it is inserted just before the list end marker; otherwise the list is walked from the end marker (list+8) until the following item has a value greater than the new item's value (stable, ascending). The item is spliced in, pvContainer (+0x10) set to the list and uxNumberOfItems incremented. Used for delayed-task lists and priority-ordered event lists.

params.name: param_2
params.description: ListItem_t* item to insert; item->xItemValue is the sort key

ble_219_0c042a14.name: uxListRemove
ble_219_0c042a14.summary: FreeRTOS: unlink an item from the list that contains it
ble_219_0c042a14.description: FreeRTOS uxListRemove: reads the owning list from pvContainer (+0x10), joins the item's neighbours, moves list->pxIndex to the previous item if it pointed at the removed one, clears pvContainer and decrements uxNumberOfItems. Returns the new item count of the list.

returns.description: number of items left in the list

ble_219_0c043364.name: prvIsQueueEmpty
ble_219_0c043364.summary: FreeRTOS queue: true when no messages are waiting
ble_219_0c043364.description: Returns (Queue_t.uxMessagesWaiting at offset 0x38) == 0. This is the body of prvIsQueueEmpty / the check used by xQueueIsQueueEmptyFromISR; callers do not necessarily hold a critical section.

returns.description: true if the queue holds no items

ble_219_0c043370.name: prvIsQueueFull
ble_219_0c043370.summary: FreeRTOS queue: true when uxMessagesWaiting equals uxLength
ble_219_0c043370.description: Returns (Queue_t.uxLength at 0x3c) == (Queue_t.uxMessagesWaiting at 0x38), i.e. the queue has no free slots. Equivalent to prvIsQueueFull / xQueueIsQueueFullFromISR.

returns.description: true if the queue is full

ble_219_0c04352c.name: ringbuf_free_space
ble_219_0c04352c.summary: Free bytes in a circular buffer descriptor (read-1-write modulo size)
ble_219_0c04352c.description: Circular-buffer helper working on a descriptor {[0]=read index, [1]=write index, [2]=size}. Computes (size + read - 1 - write) and wraps it by subtracting size when result >= size, i.e. the number of bytes that can still be written while always leaving one slot unused. Called by ble_219_0c0422d4 (likely a UART/transport TX or RX path).

params.name: param_1
params.description: ring descriptor: read idx, write idx, size

ble_219_0c04352c.notes: Field roles (read vs write index) inferred from the formula and the empty test ringbuf_is_empty.

ble_219_0c043540.name: ringbuf_used_count
ble_219_0c043540.summary: Number of bytes stored in a circular buffer descriptor
ble_219_0c043540.description: Computes (size + write - read) and wraps by subtracting size when >= size, on the descriptor {[0]=read, [1]=write, [2]=size}: the count of readable bytes. Caller ble_219_0c045534.

params.name: param_1
params.description: ring descriptor: read idx, write idx, size

ble_219_0c0437e0.name: ringbuf_is_empty
ble_219_0c0437e0.summary: True when the ring's two indices are equal
ble_219_0c0437e0.description: Returns descriptor[1] == descriptor[0] (write index equals read index), the empty condition of the circular buffer.

params.name: param_1
params.description: ring descriptor: read idx, write idx, size

returns.description: true if no data is buffered

ble_219_0c0437f0.name: ringbuf_is_full_with_reserve
ble_219_0c0437f0.summary: True when free space is at most a reserve (4 bytes if flag bit0 set at +0x1c)
ble_219_0c0437f0.description: Computes the free space of the ring as in ringbuf_free_space, then compares it with a reserve: 4 bytes when bit 0 of the byte at descriptor+0x1c is set (some extended-record mode, probably space for a length header), otherwise 0. Returns true when free <= reserve, i.e. no further record can be written. Callers ble_219_0c0424d8 and ble_219_0c046380.

params.name: param_1
params.description: ring descriptor: read idx, write idx, size, ..., flags byte at +0x1c

returns.description: true if the ring is full (within reserve)

ble_219_0c0437f0.notes: Meaning of flag bit 0 is a guess.

ble_219_0c043818.name: ringbuf_read_ptr
ble_219_0c043818.summary: Address of the current read position (base + read index)
ble_219_0c043818.description: Returns descriptor[6] (buffer base/offset, at +0x18) + descriptor[0] (read index). Used by ble_219_0c046380 to obtain the pointer for consuming data from the ring.

returns.description: pointer into the buffer at the read index

ble_219_0c043820.name: ringbuf_contig_read_len
ble_219_0c043820.summary: Contiguous readable bytes from the read index to the buffer end or write index
ble_219_0c043820.description: With read = [0], write = [1], size = [2]: returns size - read when write < read (data wraps, so only the tail segment is contiguous), else write - read. Used before a single linear copy/DMA from the ring (caller ble_219_0c046380).

params.name: param_1
params.description: ring descriptor: read idx, write idx, size

ble_219_0c0438b8.name: ringbuf_write_ptr
ble_219_0c0438b8.summary: Address of the current write position (base + write index)
ble_219_0c0438b8.description: Returns *(param_1+0x18) (buffer base) + *(param_1+4) (write index). Companion of ringbuf_read_ptr; caller ble_219_0c0462c4.

returns.description: pointer into the buffer at the write index

ble_219_0c0438c0.name: ringbuf_contig_write_len
ble_219_0c0438c0.summary: Contiguous writable bytes from the write index, keeping one slot free
ble_219_0c0438c0.description: With read = [0], write = [1], size = [2]: if write < read returns read - 1 - write; otherwise returns size - write, minus 1 when read == 0 (so the buffer never becomes completely full). Used before a linear write/receive into the ring (callers ble_219_0c04264c, ble_219_0c0462c4).

params.name: param_1
params.description: ring descriptor: read idx, write idx, size

ble_219_0c043f0c.name: vTaskSuspendAll
ble_219_0c043f0c.summary: FreeRTOS: suspend the scheduler by incrementing the nesting counter
ble_219_0c043f0c.description: Increments uxSchedulerSuspended (DAT_2000cc20). Nesting is allowed; xTaskResumeAll decrements it. Called at the start of queue, timer and event-group operations (12 callers).

ble_219_0c043f1c.name: xTaskGetTickCount
ble_219_0c043f1c.summary: FreeRTOS: return the current tick count
ble_219_0c043f1c.description: Returns xTickCount (DAT_2000cca0). Same variable is stored in a TimeOut_t by vTaskInternalSetTimeOutState. Used widely (many callers) for timeouts and timestamps.

ble_219_0c043f28.name: uxTaskGetNumberOfTasks
ble_219_0c043f28.summary: Return the RTOS word at DAT_2000cc14 (likely the number of tasks)
ble_219_0c043f28.description: Pure getter returning the kernel variable at 0x2000cc14. By its position among the FreeRTOS task globals (near the scheduler-suspended counter and scheduler-running flag) this is most likely uxCurrentNumberOfTasks, but it could be another task global such as the idle task handle. Only caller is ble_219_0c0360d4, which also calls xTaskGetCurrentTaskHandle.
ble_219_0c043f28.notes: Identity of the variable not verified.

ble_219_0c043f34.name: pcTaskGetName
ble_219_0c043f34.summary: FreeRTOS: return pointer to a task's name string
ble_219_0c043f34.description: If param_1 is non-NULL returns param_1 + 0x34, else uses the current TCB (DAT_2000cb8c) + 0x34. Offset 0x34 is pcTaskName in this build's TCB_t layout (pxTopOfStack 0, state item 4, event item 0x18, uxPriority 0x2c, pxStack 0x30). Caller ble_219_0c036328.

params.name: param_1
params.description: TaskHandle_t or NULL for the calling task

returns.description: pointer to the NUL-terminated task name

ble_219_0c044360.name: vTaskInternalSetTimeOutState
ble_219_0c044360.summary: FreeRTOS: record overflow count and tick count in a TimeOut_t
ble_219_0c044360.description: Fills param_1: [0] = xNumOfOverflows (DAT_2000cc5c), [1] = xTickCount (DAT_2000cca0). Used by queue send/receive (xQueueGenericSend/Receive/SemaphoreTake) to start a blocking-timeout measurement.

ble_219_0c0443f4.name: vTaskMissedYield
ble_219_0c0443f4.summary: FreeRTOS: flag that a context switch was requested while the scheduler was suspended
ble_219_0c0443f4.description: Sets xYieldPending (DAT_2000cca4) to 1; xTaskResumeAll yields when it later finds this flag set. Called from ble_219_0c042aac.

ble_219_0c04462c.name: xTaskGetCurrentTaskHandle
ble_219_0c04462c.description: Returns the current TCB pointer DAT_2000cb8c (the running task's handle). Eight callers in the task/queue code.

ble_219_0c044638.name: xTaskGetSchedulerState
ble_219_0c044638.summary: FreeRTOS: report scheduler not-started / running / suspended
ble_219_0c044638.description: If xSchedulerRunning (DAT_2000cc74) is 0 returns 1 (taskSCHEDULER_NOT_STARTED); else if uxSchedulerSuspended (DAT_2000cc20) is 0 returns 2 (taskSCHEDULER_RUNNING), otherwise 0 (taskSCHEDULER_SUSPENDED).

ble_219_0c0447b8.name: uxTaskResetEventItemValue
ble_219_0c0447b8.summary: FreeRTOS: return and reset the current task's event list item value
ble_219_0c0447b8.description: Reads the xEventListItem.xItemValue (TCB+0x18) of the current task, replaces it with 6 - uxPriority (TCB+0x2c; configMAX_PRIORITIES appears to be 6) and returns the old value. Used by notification/event-group wait code (caller ble_219_0c042858) to fetch the notification value that was stashed in the item.

ble_219_0c0447d0.name: pvTaskIncrementMutexHeldCount
ble_219_0c0447d0.summary: FreeRTOS: increment the running task's mutex-held counter
ble_219_0c0447d0.description: If pxCurrentTCB (DAT_2000cb8c) is non-NULL, increments the counter at TCB+0x50 (uxMutexesHeld) and returns the TCB pointer. Called by the semaphore-take path (ble_219_0c0430a8) after acquiring a mutex so priority-inheritance bookkeeping stays valid.

returns.description: current TCB (may be NULL before scheduler start)

ble_219_0c0454b4.name: app_set_word_2000de84
ble_219_0c0454b4.summary: Store param_1 into the global word DAT_2000de84
ble_219_0c0454b4.description: Plain setter: DAT_2000de84 = param_1. No direct callers, so it is invoked through a function-pointer table (an ops/config setter). The consumer and meaning of the stored value are not determined here.
ble_219_0c0454b4.notes: Likely paired with app_set_word_2000de88; purpose unknown.

ble_219_0c0454c0.name: app_set_word_2000de88
ble_219_0c0454c0.summary: Store param_1 into the global word DAT_2000de88
ble_219_0c0454c0.description: Plain setter: DAT_2000de88 = param_1. Indirect-call only; sibling of app_set_word_2000de84.

ble_219_0c0454cc.name: app_stub_return_zero_0c0454cc
ble_219_0c0454cc.description: Two-instruction function that just returns 0; no direct callers, so it is a default callback/ops-table entry that reports success or 'nothing'.

ble_219_0c04583c.name: rtos_port_yield_from_isr
ble_219_0c04583c.summary: Cortex-M: pend PendSV when param_1 is non-zero (portYIELD_FROM_ISR)
ble_219_0c04583c.description: If param_1 != 0 writes 0x10000000 (PENDSVSET, bit 28) to SCB->ICSR at 0xE000ED04, requesting a context switch at the next exception return. Implements the portYIELD_FROM_ISR(xHigherPriorityTaskWoken) macro as a function; caller ble_219_0c02feec.

params.name: param_1
params.description: non-zero if a higher priority task was woken

ble_219_0c045aac.name: startup_empty_hook_0c045aac
ble_219_0c045aac.description: Contains only a return instruction; called once from ble_219_0c028570 as a placeholder hook (e.g. an unimplemented init/optional callback).

ble_219_0c045ac0.name: ble_ram_call_2000110c_arg0
ble_219_0c045ac0.summary: Call the RAM-resident function at 0x2000110c with argument 0
ble_219_0c045ac0.description: Thunk that calls the fixed SRAM address 0x2000110d (0x2000110c with the Thumb bit) with r0 = 0 and returns. Targets code copied or patched into RAM (ROM-patch table), so the actual behaviour is not visible here. Called from ble_219_0c02cca8 and ble_219_0c0459fc.
